body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0017 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "Privileged service called with SeDebugPrivilege (4673) - Detects use of SeDebugPrivilege via privileged service calls, which can be associated with credential dumping and process injection workflows."
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0017"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1068"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "4673"
    $e.target.user.attribute.permissions.name = /sedebugprivilege/ nocase
    $name = $e.principal.hostname
    $user = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $name, $user over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $processes = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $privileges = array_distinct($e.target.user.attribute.permissions.name)

  condition:
    $e
}
